name: hbt
description: A local-first Claude companion plant that evolves with coding activity.

commands.name: init
commands.description: Initialize Habitat state and runtime prerequisites

commands.name: water
commands.description: Water your plant to restore hydration

commands.name: info
commands.description: View detailed stats and species info for your plant

commands.name: clue
commands.description: Get hints on how to help your plant grow

commands.name: reset
commands.description: Reset your plant and start fresh with a new companion

commands.name: display
commands.description: Activate the persistent plant display in the Claude Code status line

commands.name: clean
commands.description: Remove all Habitat local state and settings

commands.name: habitat-stash
commands.description: Stash your current plant into the cabinet

commands.name: habitat-cabinet
commands.description: View all stashed plants in your cabinet

commands.name: habitat-swap
commands.description: Swap your active plant with one from the cabinet
